TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Create a bot with [@BotFather](https://t.me/BotFather) and paste its HTTP API token.

WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Generate a random 64-character hexadecimal value. Telegram sends it with every webhook request.

CREDENTIAL_KEY.description: Generate a second, different random 64-character hexadecimal value used to encrypt stored VOLP credentials.
